notes: Reached entirely through the Claude-in-Chrome connector on a single tab; no curl/WebFetch/proxy. robots.txt names no AI or Claude agent and disallows only /login, /optin and two /sell/ paths. TREE: union of (a) the Furniture department page's own sub-category navigation, (b) each category page's embedded optgroup category selector (data-test-sell-local-navi-link), walked breadth-first by same-origin fetch() from the loaded page, and (c) sitemap_pages.xml (1063 category URLs). The sitemap cross-check was decisive: Sofas (/sofas-c189704/), Dining tables (/dining-tables-c172272/) and Loungers (/loungers-c189842/) are live category pages the on-page navigation does not link at all - each returns HTTP 200 with the correct h1 and breadcrumb but currently 0 products, so they are emitted as qty 0 leaves. COUNTS: every Manufactum category page renders its product count in the breadcrumb strip (e.g. 'Furniture (164)') and carries the identical string in the embedded category JSON as breadcrumb.productCount - a rendered header, Rule 1 priority. It was validated against a full count of rendered product tiles (data-test-sell-product-tile, paginated to the end) on eight nodes and matched exactly every time: Shelves 92=92, Small furniture 108=108, Kitchen furniture 62=62, Hallway furniture and wardrobes 61=61, Office Cabinets 44=44, Table trestles 17=17, Cabinets 13=13, Children's furniture 10=10. Counts differ per node (no site-wide constant), none are suspiciously round, and the h1 of every fetched page matched the node requested. SCOPE AND EXCLUSIONS: Manufactum is a very broad general retailer; only the furniture branches were enumerated. Excluded per section 1: Mattresses (/mattresses-c172283/, 5 - bedding, not furniture); Hangers and hooks (/hangers-hooks-c172277/); Table trestles and table tops (/table-trestles-table-tops-c199763/, 17) because 15 of the 17 are table frames, single table legs and mounting sets, i.e. furniture parts - flagged here because it is reversible if the orchestrator disagrees; Beanbag (/beanbag-c201314/, 2) which is two plush animal cushions, not seating. Excluded per section 3 as theme/landing pages with no category listing of their own: Multifunctional furniture (/multifunctional-furniture-c202263/), Inn furniture (/inn-furniture-c199530/), Design icons, Old Nikolai School, The Wishbone Chair by Hans J. Wegner, and the manufacturer landing pages (Fermob, Ton, Sinn, Chico, Elefant). ABSENCE CHECKED: the Bath department (/bath-c194092/) has children Bathtubs and Washbasins, Shower accessories, Other Bathroom Accessories, Soap Dishes and Dispensers, Cosmetic Mirrors - no bathroom furniture node, and a sitemap scan for bath/vanity/washstand slugs found none. Household (/household-c202241/) splits only into Household Essentials and Home Improvement. Children > Furnish and Equip yields only Children's furniture and Beanbag. Home and Living splits into Furniture, Home Accessories, Lighting, Home Textiles, Bath. OVERLAP: Manufactum runs a product-type tree and a room/context tree over one catalogue, so sibling counts legitimately exceed their parent (Seating Furniture 62 vs children 34+65+4+7; Office Furniture 30 vs Office Cabinets 44 alone). No parent total was used for a child and no children were summed. Small furniture and Kitchen furniture are childless leaves that overlap their siblings; both are flagged. Two transient HTTP 504s occurred (Hammocks, Hangers and hooks); Hammocks succeeded on a single retry. No 403, CAPTCHA, DataDome or rate-limit was encountered at any point.
